blocks.text: Furinno Pasir Series Storage and Organization cabinet bookcase feature simplicity and easy blend in with any home decor. This series comes in difference sizes in height and slightly different in door design to offer multiple options to create your own storage space. This series are made of 12mm medium density composite wood made from recycled materials of rubber trees. All the materials are manufactured in Malaysia and comply with the green rules of production. There is no foul smell, durable and the material is the most stable amongst the medium density composite woods. A simple attitude towards lifestyle is reflected directly on the design of Furinno Furniture, creating a trend of simply nature. All the products are produced and assembled 100 percent in Malaysia with 95% - 100% recycled materials. Care instructions: wipe clean with clean dry cloth. Avoid using harsh chemicals. Pictures are for illustration purpose. All decor items are not included in this offer.

items.label: WIDE & FUNCTIONAL DESIGN
items.value: This book shelf features a wide, open design rectangular shape shelves, making it ideal for living rooms, home offices, or bedrooms seeking accessible horizontal storage

items.label: 3-TIER WIDE BOOKCASE
items.value: This bookshelf provides three spacious shelves perfect for storing books, showcasing decor, or organizing office supplies while maintaining a sleek profile that blends seamlessly with both classic and modern interior styles

items.label: WEIGHT CAPACITY
items.value: Each shelf of this 3-tier bookcase holds up to 40 lbs (18.1 kg); total unit supports up to 120 lbs (54.4 kg)

items.label: STURDY BUILT
items.value: Crafted from high-quality, durable composite wood, featured back panel adds extra stability and prevents items from falling behind. Built with FSC-certified wood, it unites sustainable materials and refined craftsmanship to deliver long-term durability and reliable use
